frozen_mechanism: Build the untouched source CNF bipartite incidence graph variable<->clause.
Compute its canonical graph 2-core by deterministic degree-0/1 peeling.
Let K be every variable node remaining in the 2-core; do not search for a smaller or optimal cutset.
Use budget floor(log2 L), where L = n + sum(1+clause_width) after tautology/duplicate normalization.
If |K| exceeds the budget, return OPEN_INCIDENCE_2CORE_WIDTH before any assignment enumeration.
Otherwise enumerate exactly all 2^|K| assignments. Since 2^|K| <= L, this enumeration is polynomially bounded.
For each core assignment, simplify the source. Removing all 2-core variable nodes must leave an acyclic incidence graph; solve each residual factor tree by exact message passing.
A SAT result must carry a source-valid witness. UNSAT is authorized only after all bounded core assignments are exhausted by exact residual-tree DP.

frozen_frontier_test.corpus: same 60 mixed random formulas used by Trinity-v3 corrected checker, seed 20260914
frozen_frontier_test.target_subset: the formulas for which sealed Trinity-v3 returns OPEN_UNKNOWN_STATE_CLASS
frozen_frontier_test.success_measure: number of those frozen OPENs closed exactly by this carrier; zero closure is allowed and must be reported honestly

killer_controls: large mixed-sign incidence forest: core width 0 and exact terminal result
small cyclic core with trees attached: bounded core and exact result
large cyclic core above log budget: OPEN before enumeration
random small exact comparison against independent brute force
returned SAT witness replay on untouched source
no minimum-FVS, treewidth, backdoor search, random scoring, DPLL, general SAT oracle, or hidden assignment cube
failure_policy: Any malformed certificate, residual cycle after admitted cut, witness replay failure, or unbounded core enumeration is FAIL/OPEN as appropriate; never infer UNSAT from OPEN.
not_proved: No theorem that every mixed-sign 3CNF has logarithmic incidence 2-core variable width.
No theorem that the carrier closes every Trinity-v3 OPEN.
